description: This file declares utility functions related to file synchronization and JSON settings persistence within the Utils namespace, including functions for syncing a file to disk and persisting JSON settings to a file.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified file to disk by opening, flushing, syncing, and closing the file.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists JSON settings to a file by reading existing settings, updating with new values, and ensuring the file is synchronized to disk.
